questions.question: Paul wrote that if our earthly tent is dismantled, we have something from God. What is it?

answers.text: A longer stay in this tent

questions.question: Paul wrote that God has given believers something as a pledge of what is to come. What is it?
According to Paul, how do believers walk while they are away from the Lord?

answers.text: By faith and not by sight
By sight and not by faith

questions.question: Paul wrote that he and the believers must all appear somewhere to receive what is due for things done in the body. Where?

answers.text: Before the judgment seat of Christ
